<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=utf8><meta name=viewport content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><style>:root{color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}body{margin:0;padding:0;font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;background:#fff;color:#000}img{max-width:100%}[hidden]:not([hidden=until-found i]){display:none!important}</style></head><body>
<title>realme run</title>
<style>
:root { color-scheme:dark; --y:#ffc800; --bg:#0b1220; --panel:rgba(12,20,36,.88); --txt:#f3f6fb; --mut:#9aa7bd; --acc:#1ba784; --danger:#ff4d4d; --safe-t:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); --safe-b:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px); --safe-l:env(safe-area-inset-left,0px); --safe-r:env(safe-area-inset-right,0px); }
* { box-sizing:border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent; user-select:none; -webkit-user-select:none; }
html,body { margin:0; height:100%; overflow:hidden; background:var(--bg); color:var(--txt); font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif; overscroll-behavior:none; touch-action:none; }
#app { position:fixed; inset:0; }
#c { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; display:block; touch-action:none; }
.hidden { display:none !important; }
.screen { position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; padding:calc(14px + var(--safe-t)) calc(14px + var(--safe-r)) calc(14px + var(--safe-b)) calc(14px + var(--safe-l)); z-index:10; }
.screen.center { align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:rgba(5,10,20,.55); }
.screen.modal { z-index:30; background:rgba(5,10,20,.75); }
#loading { background:var(--bg); flex-direction:column; gap:12px; }
.logo { font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.04em; font-size:clamp(40px,9vh,76px); line-height:1; color:#fff; text-shadow:0 4px 0 #0007; }
.logo span { color:var(--y); margin-left:.12em; }
.logo.big { font-size:64px; color:var(--y); }
.tagline { color:#d3dcea; text-shadow:0 2px 6px #000a; margin:6px 0 14px; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; font-size:13px; }
.menu-col { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; width:min(360px,46vw); align-self:center; margin-left:max(0px,2vw); background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(5,10,20,.7),rgba(5,10,20,0)); padding:16px; border-radius:18px; }
.balance-row { display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:4px; }
.chip { background:#ffffff18; border:1px solid #ffffff22; border-radius:999px; padding:6px 12px; font-size:14px; color:#fff; font-family:inherit; }
.chip.link { cursor:pointer; color:var(--y); }
.row { display:flex; gap:10px; } .row > * { flex:1; } .row.end { justify-content:flex-end; margin-top:12px; }
.btn { appearance:none; border:0; border-radius:14px; padding:14px 18px; min-height:48px; font:inherit; font-weight:700; font-size:16px; color:#fff; background:#2a3550; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .08s,filter .15s; }
.btn:hover { filter:brightness(1.15); } .btn:active { transform:scale(.97); }
.btn.primary { background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffd633,#f0b400); color:#1a1300; box-shadow:0 4px 0 #a37a00; }
.btn.huge { font-size:24px; padding:18px; letter-spacing:.08em; }
.btn.ghost { background:#ffffff14; }
.btn:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:not-allowed; filter:none; }
.hint { color:var(--mut); font-size:12px; line-height:1.4; margin:6px 0 0; }
.panel { background:var(--panel); border:1px solid #ffffff1c; border-radius:20px; padding:20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; box-shadow:0 20px 60px #0009; max-height:100%; overflow:auto; touch-action:pan-y; }
.panel.narrow { width:min(400px,100%); } .panel.wide { width:min(760px,100%); }
.panel h2 { margin:0; font-size:24px; }
.panel-head { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
.muted { color:var(--mut); margin:0; } .small { font-size:13px; }
input[type=text], input:not([type]), select { width:100%; background:#ffffff12; border:1px solid #ffffff30; border-radius:12px; color:#fff; padding:12px 14px; font:inherit; font-size:16px; user-select:text; -webkit-user-select:text; }
.field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; color:var(--mut); font-size:14px; } .field input[type=range] { width:100%; accent-color:var(--y); }
.err { color:#ff8585; min-height:18px; font-size:13px; }
.cards { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr)); gap:12px; }
.card { background:#ffffff0e; border:1px solid #ffffff1c; border-radius:16px; padding:14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; text-align:center; }
.card .icon { font-size:52px; line-height:1; } .card h3 { margin:0; font-size:16px; letter-spacing:.04em; } .card p { margin:0; color:var(--mut); font-size:13px; min-height:52px; }
.card .own { color:var(--y); font-weight:700; }
.list { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; max-height:46vh; overflow:auto; }
.list .item { display:grid; grid-template-columns:36px 1fr auto auto; gap:10px; padding:8px 10px; border-radius:10px; background:#ffffff0a; font-size:14px; }
.list .item.me { background:#ffc80026; } .list .item .sc { font-weight:800; color:var(--y); } .list .item .ds { color:var(--mut); }
.me { color:var(--y); font-weight:700; }
.stats { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:8px; } .stats div { background:#ffffff0e; border-radius:12px; padding:10px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; } .stats span { color:var(--mut); font-size:12px; } .stats b { font-size:22px; }
.record { text-align:center; font-weight:900; color:var(--y); font-size:20px; animation:pulse .8s infinite alternate; }
@keyframes pulse { to { transform:scale(1.06); } }

/* HUD */
#hud { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:5; pointer-events:none; }
.hud-top { position:absolute; top:calc(10px + var(--safe-t)); left:calc(12px + var(--safe-l)); right:calc(12px + var(--safe-r)); display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:flex-start; }
.hud-box { background:#0a1324b0; border:1px solid #ffffff22; border-radius:12px; padding:6px 12px; min-width:84px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; backdrop-filter:blur(4px); }
.hud-box .lbl { font-size:10px; color:var(--mut); letter-spacing:.1em; } .hud-box b { font-size:20px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.hud-box.phone { flex-direction:row; align-items:center; gap:6px; } .hud-box .ico { font-size:20px; } .hud-box .sub { font-size:10px; color:var(--mut); margin-left:2px; } .hud-box .sub i { font-style:normal; }
.icon-btn { pointer-events:auto; margin-left:auto; width:46px; height:46px; border-radius:12px; border:1px solid #ffffff30; background:#0a1324b0; color:#fff; font-size:16px; cursor:pointer; }
.danger { position:absolute; top:calc(62px + var(--safe-t)); left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); width:min(260px,40vw); height:14px; border-radius:8px; background:#0a1324b0; border:1px solid #ffffff22; overflow:hidden; opacity:.0; transition:opacity .3s; }
.danger.on { opacity:1; } .danger #danger-fill { height:100%; width:0; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffb300,#ff3b3b); transition:width .15s; }
.danger span { position:absolute; inset:0; font-size:9px; letter-spacing:.2em; text-align:center; line-height:14px; color:#fff; }
.bonuses { position:absolute; left:calc(12px + var(--safe-l)); bottom:calc(14px + var(--safe-b)); display:flex; gap:8px; pointer-events:auto; }
.bbtn { position:relative; width:64px; height:64px; border-radius:16px; border:2px solid #ffffff30; background:#0a1324c8; color:#fff; font-size:28px; cursor:pointer; overflow:hidden; }
.bbtn .cnt { position:absolute; right:5px; bottom:2px; font-size:13px; font-weight:800; color:var(--y); } .bbtn .key { position:absolute; left:5px; top:2px; font-size:10px; color:var(--mut); }
.bbtn.active { border-color:var(--y); box-shadow:0 0 14px #ffc80088; } .bbtn.empty { opacity:.45; }
.bbtn .bar { position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0; height:5px; background:var(--y); width:0; }
.touch { position:absolute; right:calc(14px + var(--safe-r)); bottom:calc(14px + var(--safe-b)); display:none; gap:12px; pointer-events:auto; }
.tbtn { width:76px; height:76px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid #ffffff40; background:#0a1324b8; color:#fff; font-size:30px; }
.touch-only { display:none; } @media (pointer:coarse) { .touch { display:flex; } .touch-only { display:block; } .desktop-only { display:none; } .menu-col { width:min(340px,52vw); } }
.countdown { position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:min(30vh,200px); font-weight:900; color:var(--y); text-shadow:0 8px 0 #0006,0 0 40px #ffc80088; z-index:20; pointer-events:none; animation:pop .5s ease-out; }
@keyframes pop { from { transform:scale(1.6); opacity:0; } to { transform:scale(1); opacity:1; } }
.toast { max-width:78vw; text-align:center; position:absolute; top:calc(150px + var(--safe-t)); left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); background:#000b; border:1px solid #ffffff30; padding:10px 18px; border-radius:999px; z-index:25; font-weight:700; pointer-events:none; }
@media (max-width:560px) and (orientation:portrait) { .menu-col { width:100%; margin:0; align-self:flex-end; gap:8px; padding:14px 6px 6px; background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(8,14,28,.95) 72%,rgba(8,14,28,0)); } .logo { font-size:44px; } .tagline { margin:0 0 6px; } .btn { padding:12px 14px; } .btn.huge { font-size:22px; padding:14px; } .hint { display:none; } .bonuses { bottom:calc(98px + var(--safe-b)); } .bbtn { width:58px; height:58px; font-size:24px; } .tbtn { width:70px; height:70px; } .hud-box { min-width:64px; padding:5px 8px; } .hud-box b { font-size:16px; } }
@media (max-height:420px) { .logo { font-size:38px; } .tagline { margin:0 0 6px; } .btn { padding:10px 14px; min-height:40px; } .btn.huge { font-size:20px; padding:12px; } .hint { display:none; } .menu-col { gap:6px; } .bbtn { width:54px; height:54px; } .tbtn { width:64px; height:64px; } }

/* Комбо за смартфоны подряд */
.combo { position:absolute; top:calc(84px + var(--safe-t)); left:12px; min-width:104px; padding:6px 12px 8px; border-radius:14px; background:#0a1324c8; border:1px solid #ffc80066; color:#fff; opacity:0; transform:scale(.85); transform-origin:left top; transition:opacity .2s, transform .2s; pointer-events:none; }
.combo.on { opacity:1; transform:scale(1); }
.combo b { display:block; font-size:30px; line-height:1; color:#ffc800; text-shadow:0 2px 0 #0006; }
.combo span { font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.08em; opacity:.8; }
.combo .cbar { margin-top:5px; height:4px; border-radius:3px; background:#ffffff26; overflow:hidden; }
.combo .cbar i { display:block; height:100%; width:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffc800,#ff9f1c); }
.combo.sale { border-color:#ff4d6d; box-shadow:0 0 18px #ff4d6d66; } .combo.sale b { color:#ff6b8b; }
.combo { top:calc(76px + var(--safe-t)); min-width:92px; padding:4px 10px 6px; } .combo b { font-size:24px; } .combo span { font-size:10px; }

/* Задания и баннер зоны */
.missions { position:absolute; top:calc(64px + var(--safe-t)); right:calc(10px + var(--safe-r)); width:min(188px,44vw); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; pointer-events:none; }
.missions div { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:3px 7px; border-radius:9px; background:#0a1324b0; font-size:10.5px; line-height:1.15; color:#fff; border:1px solid #ffffff1c; }
.missions i { flex:none; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:4px; border:1.5px solid #ffffff66; font-style:normal; font-size:10px; line-height:10px; text-align:center; color:#0a1324; }
.missions span { flex:1; } .missions em { flex:none; font-style:normal; font-weight:800; color:#ffc800; }
.missions .ok { border-color:#46e08b88; background:#0d2a1ec0; } .missions .ok i { background:#46e08b; border-color:#46e08b; } .missions .ok span { opacity:.75; text-decoration:line-through; } .missions .ok em { color:#7dffb0; }
.zone { position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:26%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:2px; z-index:22; pointer-events:none; text-align:center; animation:zonein 2.8s ease-out forwards; }
.zone small { font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.35em; color:#ffc800; } .zone b { font-size:clamp(24px,7vw,44px); letter-spacing:.06em; color:#fff; text-shadow:0 4px 0 #0007,0 0 28px #000a; } .zone span { font-size:13px; color:#e9eefc; text-shadow:0 2px 6px #000a; }
@keyframes zonein { 0% { opacity:0; transform:translateY(14px) scale(.94); } 14% { opacity:1; transform:none; } 80% { opacity:1; } 100% { opacity:0; transform:translateY(-8px); } }
.shop-sub { grid-column:1/-1; margin:8px 0 0; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:.2em; color:var(--y); text-transform:uppercase; }
.card.on { border-color:var(--y); box-shadow:0 0 16px #ffc80055; }
#shop-cards { max-height:62vh; overflow:auto; }

/* Эффекты скорости */
.fx { position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; opacity:1; overflow:hidden; z-index:2; transition:opacity .25s; }
.fx::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:-25%; top:-25%; width:150%; height:150%; background:repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 52%, #fff0 0 6deg, #ffffffcc 6.3deg 7.4deg, #fff0 7.7deg 13deg); -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 52%, transparent 34%, #000 78%); mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 52%, transparent 34%, #000 78%); animation:fxspin 7s linear infinite; opacity:var(--r,0); }
.fx::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; box-shadow:inset 0 0 90px 18px #0000; transition:box-shadow .2s; }
.fx.danger::after { box-shadow:inset 0 0 110px 26px #ff1f3a88; } .fx.slip::after { box-shadow:inset 0 0 90px 20px #54b6ff66; }
@keyframes fxspin { to { transform:rotate(360deg); } }
@media (max-width:640px) { #shop-cards { grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:8px; } .card { padding:10px 8px; gap:5px; } .card .icon { font-size:34px; } .card h3 { font-size:13px; } .card p { font-size:11px; min-height:0; } .card .btn { padding:8px 6px; font-size:13px; } .card .own { font-size:12px; } }

.credits { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 11px; color: #9fb0cf; text-align: center; max-width: 320px; }
.credits summary { cursor: pointer; opacity: .7; }
.credits p { margin: 6px 0 0; line-height: 1.45; opacity: .8; }

.days { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr); gap:6px; margin:10px 0 14px; }
.day { background:rgba(255,255,255,.07); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-radius:10px; padding:8px 2px; text-align:center; font-size:11px; color:#c9d2ee; }
.day b { display:block; font-size:15px; color:#fff; margin-top:3px; }
.day.past { opacity:.45; }
.day.now { background:linear-gradient(160deg,#ffc800,#ff9f1c); color:#2a1a00; border-color:#fff3b0; transform:scale(1.08); box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,200,0,.5); }
.day.now b { color:#2a1a00; }
.day.big { border-color:#ffc800; }

html,body { height:100%; margin:0; background:#0b1220; }
</style>
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": { "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js", "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/" } }
</script>
<div id="app">
  <canvas id="c"></canvas>

  <!-- HUD -->
  <div id="fx" class="fx"></div>
  <div id="hud" class="hidden">
    <div class="hud-top">
      <div class="hud-box"><span class="lbl">СЧЁТ</span><b id="h-score">0</b></div>
      <div class="hud-box"><span class="lbl">МЕТРЫ</span><b id="h-dist">0</b></div>
      <div class="hud-box phone"><span class="ico">📱</span><b id="h-phones">0</b><span class="sub">всего <i id="h-bal">0</i></span></div>
      <button id="btn-pause" class="icon-btn" aria-label="Пауза">❚❚</button>
    </div>
    <div id="combo" class="combo"><b id="combo-x">×1</b><span id="combo-n"></span><div class="cbar"><i id="combo-bar"></i></div></div>
    <div id="missions" class="missions"></div>
    <div id="danger" class="danger"><div id="danger-fill"></div><span>ОХРАННИК</span></div>
    <div id="bonuses" class="bonuses"></div>
    <div id="touch" class="touch">
      <button id="t-slide" class="tbtn" aria-label="Скольжение">⤓</button>
      <button id="t-jump" class="tbtn" aria-label="Прыжок">⤒</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="countdown" class="countdown hidden"></div>
  <div id="zone" class="zone hidden"><small id="zone-n"></small><b id="zone-t"></b><span id="zone-s"></span></div>
  <div id="toast" class="toast hidden"></div>

  <!-- Экраны -->
  <section id="loading" class="screen center"><div class="logo big">realme run</div><p id="loading-text">Загрузка…</p></section>

  <section id="nick" class="screen center hidden">
    <div class="panel narrow">
      <h2>Как вас зовут?</h2>
      <p class="muted">Ник появится в таблице рекордов. 3–16 символов: буквы, цифры, _</p>
      <input id="nick-input" maxlength="16" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Ваш ник">
      <div id="nick-err" class="err"></div>
      <button id="nick-ok" class="btn primary">Продолжить</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="menu" class="screen hidden">
    <div class="menu-col">
      <div class="logo">realme<span>run</span></div>
      <div class="tagline">Побег из Техномаркета</div>
      <div class="balance-row"><span class="chip">📱 <b id="m-balance">0</b></span><span class="chip">🏆 <b id="m-best">0</b></span><button id="m-nick" class="chip link"></button></div>
      <button id="btn-play" class="btn primary huge">ИГРАТЬ</button>
      <div class="row">
        <button id="btn-shop" class="btn">Магазин</button>
        <button id="btn-board" class="btn">Рейтинг</button>
      </div>
      <div class="row">
        <button id="btn-settings" class="btn ghost">Настройки</button>
        <button id="btn-mute" class="btn ghost" aria-label="Звук">🔊</button>
      </div>
      <p class="hint desktop-only">A/D — дорожки · W/Пробел — прыжок · S — скольжение · Q/E/R — бонусы · Esc — пауза</p>
      <p class="hint touch-only">Свайпы: влево/вправо — дорожка, вверх — прыжок, вниз — скольжение</p>
      <details class="credits"><summary>Авторы 3D-моделей</summary>
        <p>BoomBox, Water Bottle, Avocado — Microsoft / Khronos glTF-Sample-Assets (CC0, CC-BY 4.0).<br>Диван и кресла — Wayfair, LLC (CC-BY 4.0).<br>Растение и чашка — Darmstadt Graphics Group (CC-BY 4.0, CC0).<br>Фургон Cesium Milk Truck — Cesium (CC-BY 4.0).<br>Дорожный конус — hinndia, Sketchfab (CC-BY 4.0).<br>Робот RobotExpressive — Tomás Laulhé / Quaternius (CC0).</p></details>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="shop" class="screen center hidden">
    <div class="panel wide">
      <div class="panel-head"><h2>Магазин бонусов</h2><span class="chip">📱 <b id="s-balance">0</b></span></div>
      <div id="shop-cards" class="cards"></div>
      <div class="row end"><button id="shop-back" class="btn">Назад</button><button id="shop-play" class="btn primary">Играть</button></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="board" class="screen center hidden modal">
    <div class="panel wide">
      <div class="panel-head"><h2>Рейтинг</h2><span id="board-status" class="chip"></span></div>
      <div id="board-me" class="me"></div>
      <div id="board-list" class="list"></div>
      <div class="row end"><button id="board-close" class="btn">Закрыть</button></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="settings" class="screen center hidden modal">
    <div class="panel narrow">
      <h2>Настройки</h2>
      <label class="field">Музыка <input id="set-music" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.05"></label>
      <label class="field">Звуки <input id="set-sfx" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.05"></label>
      <label class="field">Качество
        <select id="set-quality"><option value="low">Низкое</option><option value="medium">Среднее</option><option value="high">Высокое</option></select>
      </label>
      <label class="field">Ник <input id="set-nick" maxlength="16" autocomplete="off"></label>
      <div id="set-err" class="err"></div>
      <div class="row end"><button id="set-close" class="btn primary">Готово</button></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="daily" class="screen center hidden modal">
    <div class="panel">
      <h2>Ежедневный бонус</h2>
      <p id="daily-sub" class="hint"></p>
      <div id="daily-days" class="days"></div>
      <div class="row end"><button id="daily-claim" class="btn primary">Забрать</button></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="pause" class="screen center hidden">
    <div class="panel narrow">
      <h2>Пауза</h2>
      <button id="p-resume" class="btn primary">Продолжить</button>
      <button id="p-restart" class="btn">Начать заново</button>
      <button id="p-settings" class="btn ghost">Настройки</button>
      <button id="p-menu" class="btn ghost">В главное меню</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="results" class="screen center hidden">
    <div class="panel narrow">
      <h2>Вас поймали!</h2>
      <div id="r-record" class="record hidden">🎉 НОВЫЙ РЕКОРД!</div>
      <div class="stats">
